kvendra-cloud.description: Kvendra hosted KB engine: entity_*, txn_*, work (the work cycle), help and the other KB tools (whoami, config_get, task_context, export, check_notifications, disputes, proposals, messages, file_*, private_value_resolve, k_note_*). Auth: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE against auth.kvendra.cloud (Cognito Hosted UI). Pro tier required — see https://app.kvendra.cloud/docs/. Server name is `kvendra-cloud` (not `kvendra`) to avoid colliding with the local `kvendra` CLI MCP server — Claude Code resolves same-name servers by scope precedence and Local > Plugin, so a same-name plugin server gets eclipsed silently. The `${KVENDRA_WS:-}` suffix is the multi-account switch (PAT-KVD-SKILLS-CEDB12): unset it expands to the bare URL byte for byte, so existing credentials stay valid; set it (e.g. `?ws=acme`) per directory to keep one OAuth credential per account. Do not remove it — see CI step `mcp-json-url`. `X-Kvendra-Client` tells the engine the plugin's major version (`kvendra-skills/<major>.0.0`, fixed for a whole major line); adding or changing a header changes the stored OAuth credential, so users authenticate once more (`/mcp` → kvendra-cloud → Authenticate). See CI step `client header matches the plugin version`.
